newsitem.title: USA: New span urged for San Francisco bridge - report.
newsitem.headline: New span urged for San Francisco bridge - report.

text.p: A confidential report urges the state to build an entirely new span for the San Francisco Bay Bridge rather than retrofit the structure, according to a published report Thursday.

The report, prepared for the California Department of Transportation by an independent engineering firm, recommended building a new east span to the bridge at a cost of between $600 and $700 million, the San Francisco Chronicle reported.
The projected cost of the new double-decker span would be hundreds of millions of dollars less than the cost of the current retrofit plan, according to the Chronicle.
Department spokesman John Barna said no decision had been made on a final recommendation to Gov. Pete Wilson.
